title: SiteStore interface with file-seeded and database-backed stores
description:
What: one interface for site config, brand pack, pages and nav, with a file-seeded backing (today's repositories) and a database-plus-S3 backing. Config text goes to S3; DynamoDB holds keys and pointers only.
Acceptance:
Scenario: Both stores produce identical output
  Given TI and MoM configuration loaded from files and from the store
  When each site is built
  Then the output is byte identical

comments.author: home
comments.text: The database-backed store is PPY-c020ce (catalogue rows, documents in S3) with PPY-1252ce; the shared renderer reading it is PPY-413576. Verified: content-actions is built with the site's web/ bundled in (amplify/functions/content-actions/resource.ts setSiteFilesForContentActionsBundle; site-backend.ts line 125), which the memo marked as inferred.
